notes: Has the same form for masculine and feminine (un café suave, una cobija suave).
False friend: rarely means 'suave' (charming and elegant); in everyday Spanish it means 'soft', 'smooth', or 'mild'. In informal Mexican Spanish, it can also mean 'cool' or 'great' (¡Qué suave!).
